title: Autopsy conducted on Port Hardy man who died following night in custody
article: An autopsy was carried out yesterday on a 43-year-old Port Hardy man who died days after RCMP arrested him for public intoxication.
Albert William Prevost was first arrested by Port Hardy RCMP on March 13 and spent the night in police cells.

By morning he appeared to be suffering from a medical problem and was taken by ambulance to Port Hardy General Hospital. Prevost was then transferred to Campbell River Hospital, where he died on Sunday.
Results of the autopsy have not yet been made public, but the death is under investigation by the coroner, the RCMP and the Vancouver Island Integrated Major Crime Unit.
